description: Look up the BRC-100 identity key a domain handle (a domain, or name@domain) points at. The answer comes from the domain's _metanet TXT record in public DNS: identity_key is the 66-hex compressed public key or null, record is the DNS name it came from, and dnssec is validated (the resolver checked the DNSSEC signatures), unsigned or unknown. Every name@domain resolves to the domain's key. error is set when the domain has several identity records or one that cannot be read. This is the domain owner's claim; it does not prove the key holder agrees.
name: resolve_identity
title: Which BRC-100 identity a domain points at
